Get Started Intellipaint LLC (615)971-9905 Licensed & Insured Color Consultants Home Services About About Contact Services Professional residential painting Residential "Transform Your Home with Exquisite Paintcraft Our residential painting services at Intellipaint offer more than just a fresh coat of paint. We specialize in turning houses into personalized sanctuaries, infusing colors that resonate with your style and breathe life into your living spaces. From vibrant accent walls to seamless full-room makeovers, our team of skilled artisans pays meticulous attention to detail, ensuring flawless finishes and a transformative ambiance. We pride ourselves on using premium-quality paints, advanced techniques, and a keen eye for design to elevate every corner of your home. Whether it's interior rejuvenation or exterior curb appeal enhancement, trust us to bring your vision to life. We work closely with homeowners, listening to preferences and offering professional guidance to create spaces that reflect your personality and aspirations. Intellipaint's residential painting services – where expertise meets your dream home." Cabinet painting ​ "Elevate Your Kitchen with Superior Cabinet Refacing At Intellipaint, our cabinet refacing services redefine kitchen aesthetics, marrying elegance with functionality. We specialize in reviving tired cabinets, and breathing new life into your kitchen space while maintaining the highest standards of quality craftsmanship. Using only premium-grade paints and top-notch materials, our skilled artisans meticulously transform your cabinets. Our commitment to excellence ensures a durable and stunning finish, enhancing both the beauty and longevity of your kitchen fixtures. With an array of color options and finishes, we tailor our services to match your style preferences and elevate the ambiance of your kitchen. Our refined techniques and attention to detail guarantee a flawless result, turning outdated cabinets into captivating focal points. Experience the fusion of artistry and durability with Intellipaint's cabinet refacing services. Discover a kitchen that exudes sophistication and stands the test of time." "Premium Painting Mastery & Beyond: Complete Transformative Solutions" "Crafting Perfection Beyond Paint: Our Comprehensive Painting Solutions At Intellipaint, our commitment to excellence extends far beyond the brush. We offer a holistic painting experience encompassing meticulous services, setting the benchmark for transformative home beautification. From precision drywall repairs to flawlessly preparing surfaces, our adept team ensures a seamless canvas for the perfect coat. We meticulously address imperfections, ensuring every surface is immaculate before the first stroke of paint. Utilizing cutting-edge laser technology, our color-matching expertise guarantees precise hues, seamlessly blending your vision with reality. This advanced approach ensures a harmonious color palette that resonates throughout your space. Our dedication to perfection reflects in our attention to detail, ensuring each corner receives the same level of meticulous care. Whether it's trim work that demands finesse or textured finishes that demand precision, our artisans excel in every facet of the painting process. At Intellipaint, we believe that the artistry lies in the details. From meticulous prep work to innovative color technology, our comprehensive painting solutions redefine craftsmanship, transforming spaces into breathtaking works of art." COLOR Welcome to Intellipaint LLC Where Painting is Our Passion Intellipaint LLC is a professional painting contractor that specializes in providing high-quality residential interior and exterior painting services, log cabin and fence staining, cabinet refacing, drywall work, and more. We take pride in our work and are passionate about delivering exceptional results to our clients. Our experienced team of painters uses high-quality paints and the latest techniques to ensure a flawless finish that will exceed your expectations. Residential Exterior Painting If you're looking to enhance the curb appeal of your home, our residential exterior painting services are just what you need. We use premium quality paints and finishes that can withstand harsh weather conditions and provide long-lasting protection to your home's exterior. Log Cabin & Fence Staining Our log cabin and fence staining services can help protect and beautify your wooden structures. We use high-quality stains and finishes that can enhance the natural beauty of wood and provide protection against rot, decay, and insects. Cabinet Refacing & Drywall Work If you're looking to update the look of your kitchen or bathroom, our cabinet refacing services can give your cabinets a brand new look without the need for a complete overhaul. We also specialize in drywall work that can help repair and restore damaged walls and ceilings.
